1.explanation: • lib/import/BpmnImporter.js: This file reads the BPMNDI bounds and creates the shape primitives (x, y, width, height) but doesn’t inspect the isHorizontal=false flag. As a result, vertical pools aren’t rotated or resized (width/height swapped), so the pool bar and lane bars still draw horizontally and label bounds are incorrect. • lib/draw/BpmnRenderer.js: This renderer draws the BPMN shapes and labels based on the element properties but never checks di.isHorizontal. It should rotate pool and lane labels (or swap width/height for participant shapes) when isHorizontal=false, but currently always renders the same horizontal shape and text orientation.
1.bug_scenario: The A.4.1 test diagram defines a two-participant collaboration with both horizontal and vertical pools (participants). In the provided import, the second pool and its lanes are marked in the BPMNDI with isHorizontal="false" (i.e. vertical orientation). However, when rendered: • The pool and lane bars still render as if horizontal • The pool label stays unrotated (horizontal) and is clipped • Lane labels are placed incorrectly (or omitted) • Bounds/width/height are never swapped to account for vertical orientation In short, the DI flag is ignored, so the entire pool and its labels render like a horizontal pool rather than rotating the shape and text for a vertical orientation.
